build_parallel_backend: build a parallel backend by subclassing BaseParallelBackend to implement distributed training with DDP, FSDP2, or context parallel
create_checkpointer: create a checkpointer by subclassing BaseCheckpointer to save and load model checkpoints during training
test_initialize_trackers: test the BaseParallelBackend.initialize_trackers method to set up logging trackers for main and non-main processes
refactor_apply_ddp: refactor the BaseParallelBackend.apply_ddp method to apply distributed data parallel training to a PyTorch model
summarize_base_checkpointer: summarize the BaseCheckpointer class and its save and load methods for managing training checkpoints
